name: korean-humanities
description: Korean humanities research plugins for Claude Code - pick what you need: research methods (korean-humanities), gugyeol/old-Hangul recovery (gugyeol-decode), KCI citation networks (kci-citation-network).

plugins.name: korean-humanities
plugins.description: Korean humanities research methods for Claude Code - hanmun source criticism, hermeneutic argument planning, humanities peer review, and academic English editing. Prompt-only, zero setup.

plugins.name: gugyeol-decode
plugins.description: Recover gugyeol (口訣) characters and old Hangul in Korean academic PDFs/HWPX that extract as broken (cid:N) or PUA codepoints. Mapping tables bundled; optional pip install pymupdf for PDF input.

plugins.name: kci-citation-network
plugins.description: Self-serve KCI citation network builder for Korean humanities - give a keyword, collect citation edges via the KCI reference OpenAPI (free data.go.kr key), optionally render Obsidian notes. Stdlib-only scripts, no LLM calls.

plugins.name: kci-korean-studies-trends
plugins.description: Build your own year x field KCI corpus (no API key; polite web collection with a user-editable journal profile) and generate hallucination-resistant Korean-studies trend reports - topic clusters, representative-paper candidates, journal breakdowns. Stdlib-only, no LLM calls.
